mapper.select: SELECT SUM(count) FROM stat_svc_rpt WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT daily_pend_count FROM stat_svc_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT svc_complete_rate FROM stat_svc_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT overdue_svc_count FROM stat_svc_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT st.type_name, SUM(sr.count) as count FROM stat_svc_rpt sr LEFT JOIN sys_svc_type st ON sr.type_code = st.type_code AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE sr.deleted = 0 GROUP BY st.type_name
SELECT HOUR(stat_time) as hour, SUM(handle_count) as handle_count FROM stat_svc_rpt WHERE deleted = 0 AND stat_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY HOUR(stat_time) ORDER BY hour
